Package com.im.njams.sdk.serializer

Interface Serializer<T>

  • Type Parameters:
    T - generic
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    JsonSerializer, StringSerializer, XmlSerializer
    public interface Serializer<T>
    Serializer interface. Implementations turn a typed object into a String representation, optionally respecting a maximum string length to avoid producing very large strings that will be truncated downstream.

    Implementations must declare serialize(Object, int) and return a SerializerResult carrying the serialized string and an explicit truncated flag. Honouring the sizeLimit argument is optional, but the truncated flag must always be set correctly: it is the SDK's only reliable signal that the output is incomplete (callers must not infer truncation from the string length). Honouring sizeLimit is encouraged because it can save significant CPU and memory when serializing large objects that would otherwise be built in full and then clipped; an implementation that cannot easily limit its output may serialize the whole object and report truncated from a length comparison.

    The single-argument serialize(Object) is a convenience that serializes with no effective limit and therefore can never truncate; it returns the plain string.

    The SDK ships two implementations:

    • JsonSerializer — serializes via Jackson and honours sizeLimit effectively, aborting the stream once the limit is reached so a large object is never fully materialised; it reports truncated precisely from that abort.
    • StringSerializer — serializes via Object.toString(). Because it must build the complete toString() result before it can clip it, it cannot limit work or memory during serialization; passing sizeLimit only trims the already-allocated string. It reports truncated from the length comparison. Prefer a serializer that truncates effectively (such as JsonSerializer, or a custom implementation) whenever that is feasible, and reserve StringSerializer for cases where no better option exists.

    stkniep

    • Method Detail

      • serialize

        default String serialize​(T object)
                  throws NjamsSdkRuntimeException
        Serialize given Object to String with no effective size limit.

        With no limit the result can never be truncated, so this convenience returns the plain string. The default implementation delegates to serialize(Object, int) passing Integer.MAX_VALUE and unwraps the SerializerResult.value(). Implementations may override this method to provide a faster unlimited path that skips size-tracking bookkeeping.

        Parameters:
        object - Object to be serialized
        Returns:
        String representation for the given Object
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if serialization fails

      • serialize

        SerializerResult serialize​(T object,
                           int sizeLimit)
                    throws NjamsSdkRuntimeException
        Serialize given Object, respecting the given size limit when greater than 0, and report whether the output had to be truncated.

        Honouring sizeLimit is optional but recommended: stopping output once roughly sizeLimit characters have been produced avoids building large strings, saving CPU and memory. Implementations that cannot easily do this may ignore sizeLimit and serialize the whole object, reporting truncated from a length comparison.

        The SerializerResult.truncated() flag is mandatory and must be true exactly when the object was larger than sizeLimit (so the returned value is incomplete). A sizeLimit of Integer.MAX_VALUE or any non-positive value means "no limit", in which case the result is never truncated.

        Parameters:
        object - Object to be serialized
        sizeLimit - Recommended (not mandatory) upper bound for the produced string length when positive and less than Integer.MAX_VALUE; otherwise the limit is ignored
        Returns:
        the serialized value together with the truncation flag, or null if the implementation represents a null object as null
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if serialization fails
